text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching this UmaTuber's
twenty-four
hour livestream since last
night now... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's fallen asleep... I could
look at
her sleeping face forever. She's a
real-life an...gel.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No! Must stay awake! Mustn't miss... this

pre...cious scene...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After staying up all night watching
UmaTube,
Agnes Digital is in a constant
battle against
falling asleep.
